A '''[[GPE-7300 space transport]]''' belonged to the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]]. The vessel possessed a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]].

When Rae spotted [[Cade Skywalker]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], she followed him in the ship to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. She safely landed her ship outside [[Rawk's Nest]].
